turns.text: Lloyd, my coffee maker is leaking again. I think the gasket is shot.
That's frustrating. Have you checked if it's the water tank seal or the brew head gasket? Usually, a quick replacement fixes it.
I'll check the brew head later. Anyway, I finally got DexGrasp-VLA running on the local setup. The architecture is pretty clever.
Glad to hear it! What stands out to you about the architecture?
It uses shared autonomy with a macro/micro split. That design really helps with the latency issues we were seeing before.
That makes sense. Separating high-level planning from low-level execution usually improves responsiveness significantly.
Exactly. Now, back to the coffee maker—do you know if I can order a replacement gasket from the same site I used for the filter paper?
Most coffee brands sell parts directly, but check if your model number is compatible. I can look it up if you provide the brand.
